fieldName.description: Name of the Cloud Resource field for this reference.

title:
Canonical representation of a reference to a Cloud Resource.

Cloud providers typically are not very consistent in the way references to cloud resources are managed. I.e. given
resource type may use field named `id`, `name` or alternative to identify the resource. Sometime more then one field
can uniquely identify the resource and what's worse different API can return different fields and values to identify
same resource.

C3 is using CloudRef to remove this ambiguity.

Additionally CloudRef implements consistent way to encode such references into string. This string then can be used
elsewhere like in a corresponding config file name.

@see CloudRef
@see #toString
@see #fromString
